exposure: history of severe nausea and vomiting during pregnancy (SNVP)
cohort: Female patients scheduled for breast cancer surgery (n=121), with 30 having a history of SNVP and 91 having a history of MNVP (data from 115 patients analyzed)
finding: Patients with a history of severe nausea and vomiting during pregnancy (SNVP) experienced a higher incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) and severe PONV, required more postoperative antiemetics, and reported lower satisfaction levels compared to patients with a history of mild NVP (MNVP).
